status_summary: Press reporting dated 2025-01-24 said the Fed, FDIC, OCC and CFTC had removed diversity office web pages and the SEC had removed its DEI page, while it was unclear whether any office had closed; Bloomberg Law reported on 2025-04-14 that the SEC's Office of Minority and Women Inclusion web page had disappeared. As of 2026-10-14 an SEC page for that office still describes it as active, with an acting director and diversity programs. On the SRO side, Nasdaq filed on 2025-01-21 a rule change, operative on filing and tied to a 2025-02-04 effective date (SEC notice published 2025-01-30, 90 FR 8554), repealing its board diversity listing requirements to reflect a federal court's vacatur of the SEC's 2021 approval order. No closure of a financial regulator's diversity office, repeal of the statutory offices, or statute barring discrimination by securities regulators and SROs was found.

timeline.event: Nasdaq filed a rule change (SR-NASDAQ-2025-007) repealing its board diversity listing requirements to reflect a federal court's vacatur of the SEC's 2021 approval order; the SEC waived the 30-day operative delay so the change was operative on filing, tied to the court decision's effective date of 2025-02-04, and the SEC notice (Release No. 34-102281, dated 2025-01-24) was published 2025-01-30 at 90 FR 8554.
Press reporting said the Fed, FDIC, OCC, CFTC and SEC had removed DEI or diversity office web pages as of 2025-01-23, with the SEC's OMWI page still up at that time.
Bloomberg Law reported that the SEC's web page for its mandated Office of Minority and Women Inclusion had been removed, and that it was unclear whether the office still operated.

title: End DEI offices and race- or sex-based appointment rules at financial regulators and SROs
uncertainties: The Nasdaq notice (90 FR 8554) was re-read in this review on federalregister.gov; it does not name the vacating court or list the rule numbers. The SEC Office of Minority and Women Inclusion page was read on sec.gov by the researcher on 2026-10-18 and still presents the office as active, but it shows a 2017 modified date and cites FY 2023 materials, so its currency is unclear. The Federal Reserve OMWI page could not be fetched. The statutory basis (Dodd-Frank section 342) is from general knowledge. The Nasdaq repeal followed a court vacatur and reflects alignment, not an SEC policy choice, and the rule required board diversity or an explanation, close to but not the same as appointment rules by race or sex. Federal Register API searches since 2025-01-20 for Office of Minority and Women Inclusion found only an FDIC information collection renewal (2025-01-22). One web search for closures of financial regulator diversity offices returned only an undated CFPB diversity office story (not opened) and older materials. CFTC action beyond web page removal was not found, and web page removals rest on news reports.
